text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Nggghhhh! Geez! Are you two absolute 
idiots?! 
I HATE this! You'd better go back to your 
normal selves right this instant——!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan, where did your usual 
festival-girl energy even go?! 
And Satono! I'm not a hollow in an old 
tree, you know! Stop treating me like one!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A hollow in a tree...? Dia-chan, did you 
tell her something...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Stuff like Kitasan sneaking off in the 
middle of the night, or feeling distant 
lately, 
or how right after enrolling you hung out 
with me all the time because deep down—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Please stop! 
I... I want to tell her with my own words!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, do whatever you want! I don't care 
about your messy drama anyway. 
You two childhood friends can sort it out 
yourselves!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...You better be back to normal the next 
time I see you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san...! Ugh, she really is so sweet 
deep down... 
Yeah, I'm okay now... Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Hey, Dia-chan. 
I think I assumed I was the only one 
feeling lonely.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Is that so? You too, Kita-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It might take a while, but do you mind if 
I go first? 
First of all, I'm sorry for making you 
worry.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I was scared. 
Scared of all the sides of you I didn't 
know yet—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(—I poured out everything. All my fears, 
all my embarrassment, all of it.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(And then I told her what our seniors 
taught me about the things that never 
change... 
And after that, I listened to Dia-chan's 
worries too...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—I see... 
So much was going on that neither of us 
knew about.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, but that's totally natural, isn't 
it...? 
After all, we're both still growing.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's true. I'm sure we'll keep changing 
as time goes on. 
But I know we'll be just fine...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Kita-chan. Thank you for opening up 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that goes both ways! 
Thank YOU. Ehehe... I'm so glad we talked.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, ...shall we head back now? 
Let's give the ritual everything we've 
got. As long as I'm with you, Kita-chan, 
we're sure to succeed♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's do our best...! We're 
definitely going to make it a success!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And then, as the new year began, just 
before dawn on New Year's Day. 
The shrine was bustling with countless 
worshippers.

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho, it seems our publicity worked 
wonders! 
Soooo many people have come to watch the 
Umamiko Pilgrimage!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~n♪ It's almost time to start. 
Those two should be changing into their 
outfits right about—waah!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitors
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh! Go get 'em, Kita-Sato~~! 
Wah, their outfits are so cute~! So 
different from the shrine maidens I saw 
when I was little~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm starting to feel butterflies in my 
stomach! 
To think this many people came out to 
cheer for us... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's those guys from back then! 
Wow, you actually came~!

text_block_list.name: Man with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Oops, looks like they noticed us. 
Still, they're star Umamusume carrying the 
racing world on their shoulders now.

text_block_list.name: Man in Hoodie
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we shouldn't get in the way of the 
other fans. 
Let's just cheer quietly from here. 
...Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, they're heading off... 
Still, they waved back at us, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I could tell by the shape of their 
mouths 
that they were saying "Good luck!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
They probably held back since we're out in 
public. 
Even so, they're cheering for us with all 
their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You're right. ...Our distance from them 
might have changed since back then, 
but what truly matters in our hearts 
hasn't changed, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...! Yeah, totally! You're so right! 
We've changed, but... we haven't changed 
at all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And at last, the time for the Umamiko 
Pilgrimage arrived. 
With the cheers of the worshippers at 
their backs, the two set off along the 
mountain trail—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
From here to the summit before sunrise... 
With an Umamusume's legs, 
a fast-paced walk would cut it close... 
was that right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yep! It's longer than the Stayers Stakes— 
it's a real, albeit light, mountain climb. 
A totally different ballgame from our 
usual races...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The head priest said the secret is keeping 
a steady pace without breaking it. 
Alright, let's stay calm and steady! I'll 
leave the lighting to you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Understood, let us proceed!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah, look at that orange light! 
It looks like they safely lit the first 
bonfire.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Those are basically checkpoints, right? 
Hmph, so that's how we can tell how far 
they've climbed♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there are four bonfires in total, one 
every two stations. 
Lighting them isn't mandatory, so 
apparently there have been times when 
runners reached the summit without 
lighting any.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Toward the end, the maidens often don't 
even have time to light them before 
pushing onward... 
I hear it's quite common for everyone down 
here to be on pins and needles until the 
summit lights up.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What's that about? So you're saying nobody 
knows the outcome until the very end? 
Fufun♪ I'm going to believe in them right 
up to the second the morning sun rises, 
absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, that one's lit. Kita-chan, do 
you need a break? 
I can still keep going.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm good too! Let's hurry on ahead. 
At this rate, let's cover as much distance 
as we can early on!
